title: 美债波动不意外？专家建议现金与短久期配置
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This isn't a surprise what's happening. I think the surprise this week is now we have volatility in those rates thanks to the treasury.
segments.zh: 当前情况并不意外。本周的意外是，由于财政部，这些利率出现了波动。

segments.en: So I would prefer to be in cash or short-term fixed income and other types of diverseifiers dare I say at gold.
segments.zh: 所以我更倾向于持有现金或短期固定收益产品，以及我敢说的其他分散化工具，比如黄金。

segments.en: Here's the connard of the business folks bring up the chart please. This is for Rebecca Patterson Wall Street and Rebecca Patterson talk differently than mere mortals.
segments.zh: 这是商业人士的康纳德，请调出图表。这是针对丽贝卡·帕特森的，华尔街和丽贝卡·帕特森的说话方式与普通人不同。

segments.en: If you own the TLT's out 20 years plus like a lot of retail does picking up that yield it's priced down from COVID it has been a crater of yielded up price down.
segments.zh: 如果你持有20年期以上的长期国债，就像许多散户那样，为了获取收益率，价格自疫情以来已经下跌，收益率上升而价格下跌。

segments.en: In year world what's long term seven-year duration not 20 year when you're looking at retirement and wealth management.
segments.zh: 在现实世界中，当考虑退休和财富管理时，长期是七年久期，而不是20年。

segments.en: Yeah I think even shorter duration like money markets right now so the yield pickup you have by owning a longer term bond right now.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为甚至更短久期，比如货币市场，现在持有长期债券所获得的收益率溢价。

segments.en: Yes you get something for it but is it worth the risk and right now I haven't thought it is what I would say though is for retail investors if you lose money when rates going up it does depend on how fast the rates go up and it depends what the yield is.
segments.zh: 是的，你确实有所得，但值得冒这个风险吗？目前我认为不值得。但我想说的是，对于散户市场参与者，如果利率上升时你亏钱，那取决于利率上升的速度和收益率水平。

segments.en: So if I'm getting a high yield say the 30 year it's 5.24% and yields continue higher but very slowly I lose money as the prices fall in the yields go up but I'm making money on that coupon.
segments.zh: 所以如果我获得高收益率，比如30年期国债收益率是5.24%，而收益率继续缓慢上升，我会因价格下跌而亏损，但我会从票息中赚钱。
